name: King
source:
The king who imprisoned the immortal poet who goes by the name of [url=/c9036]Ma Ga Uta Tsukai[/url]. 
His kingdom and military force stand unrivaled, and his commands are passed throughout his whole peninsula country.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.ray-software.net/magauta/index.html#2]official website[/url]]
